results.title: Russians start attacking individually rather than in groups — Trehubov
results.description: Unable to overcome the kill zone in the Southern Slobozhanskyi sector, Russian forces are reducing the number of troops in assault groups to a single person.

results.title: Russia Fired 2,000 Drones and 19 Missiles This Week, Zelensky Says
results.description: Russian forces launched over 2,000 strike drones, 1,700 guided aerial bombs, and 19 missiles of various types against Ukraine over the past week, President Volodymyr Zelensky announced on Sunday, Sept. 20. Zelensky highlighted that the majority were high-speed, jet-powered drones, urging G7 and Western partners to implement stronger sanctions and pursue “peace through strength.”
